hints.title: Common High Order Bit Prefix
hints.text: Whenever numbers increment across a range, low order bits flip back and forth between zero and one, turning all trailing bits to zero in the cumulative bitwise product.

hints.title: Prefix Shift Convergence Invariant
hints.text: Repeatedly shifting both left and right values to the right until they coincide identifies their common highest binary prefix.

hints.title: Bit Shift Alignment Procedure
hints.text: Initialize a shift counter to zero. While left is strictly less than right, shift both numbers rightward by one bit and increment the counter. Once equal, shift the common value leftward by the recorded counter amount and return.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping through all integers in range [left, right] takes O(N) operations, which times out when the range spans billions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Finding the common binary prefix shifts numbers at most 32 times, running in O(1) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that only the common binary prefix survives consecutive bitwise AND operations.
